title: PAPER.Ph Magazine
client: Prime Alliance of Publishers, Editors & Reporters of the Philippines
summary: The launch issue of a national media association's magazine, plus its event print.

stats.label: issue, launched at the association's first anniversary
kinds of event print: tarpaulins, certificates, ribbons

caseStudy.brief: PAPER.Ph, a national association of publishers, editors and reporters, launched its magazine at its first anniversary under the theme “The Media, the New Era, and the New Normal.”
caseStudy.did: As Magazine Designer I designed the first issue (news, opinion, feature and message pages, photo spreads and advertiser greetings) and the tarpaulins, certificates and guest ribbons for the event.
decisions: One navy-and-gold look shared by the magazine and the event print, so everything at the anniversary belonged together.
News, opinion, message pages, photo spreads and greetings each sit within the same consistent design, so the issue reads as one publication.
